thread:
simon: Quick follow-up after the postmortem — we need firm owners + compact deadlines for the rollout/canary upgrades (auto-rollback, reduced blast radius defaults, metric gating). Please reply with one-line commitments that I can paste into the action tracker.

tara: I can pick up the feature-flag default changes and small UX tweak on the flag page. Proposal: initial exposure 0.25% for 2h, then 2% for 24h, default max 10% unless org-approved. I'll file TKT-4021 and aim for 2025-03-30.

ken: I'll own the auto-rollback plumbing (controller + test harness). Plan: add a 'rollback-hook' step that runs after detection, tests in staging, and a staged deploy to canary nodes. ETA 2025-04-06. Ticket TKT-4022.

oncall-bot: infra-alert: synthetic-canary-monitor created by infra-lead.

infra-lead: I'll stand up the synthetic canary job and wire it into the rollout controller. The job will run a small set of queries and a healthprobe every 5m and produce a status metric. Ticket TKT-4023, ETA 2025-03-27.

pm-ops: From product side — strongly prefer conservative ramps. The 0.25% initial is ok if we have clear rollback. Also need a short customer comms blurb template in case a rollback impacts behavior.

simon: Two process asks: 1) ticket summary must be "owner: name | due: yyyy-mm-dd" in the title, 2) add a one-line runbook entry that names the manual abort owner and where the abort button is in the console.

tara: Will update TKT-4021 with summary + runbook line.

ken: I'll add the rollback playbook snippet to the runbooks repo and include expected signals that trigger an auto-pause vs auto-abort.

infra-lead: Question for ken — should the synthetic job auto-fail a rollout or only trigger a pause/alert?

ken: Prefer pause+alert first, auto-abort only after corroborating signals (metric-gates + synthetic failing for 3 consecutive windows). We should avoid noisy auto-aborts.

pm-ops: Agree. Also request the docs team update the 'what to expect during a rollback' paragraph.

oncall-bot: ticket-update: TKT-4021 assigned to tara (due 2025-03-30); TKT-4022 assigned to ken (due 2025-04-06); TKT-4023 assigned to infra-lead (due 2025-03-27).

simon: Consolidated action list (please confirm and update if needed):

- Auto-rollback plumbing  owner: ken  ticket: TKT-4022  due: 2025-04-06
- Flag defaults & flag-page UX  owner: tara  ticket: TKT-4021  due: 2025-03-30
- Synthetic canary + metrics feed  owner: infra-lead  ticket: TKT-4023  due: 2025-03-27
- Runbook + customer blurb  owner: simon  ticket: TKT-4024  due: 2025-04-08

ken: I'll mark TKT-4022 in progress and post PR checklist when I have the first pass.

tara: RFC + UI mock by EOD Friday.

infra-lead: Synthetic job definition PR incoming tomorrow morning.

pm-ops: I'll prepare the customer blurb and route to comms for approval.

simon: Let's reconvene in 72 hours to validate progress and reassign if anything slips. If you hit blockers sooner, DM me. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
